LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COLLECTIVE NOUNS.

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns., part of Strand 2 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do collective nouns form their plurals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. list the collective nouns as they listen to an audio text,

2. identify collective nouns in a print text,

3. classify collective nouns according to people, animals or things,

4. discuss the plural forms of these nouns,

5. write correct sentences using collective nouns from substitution tables,

6. fill in blank spaces using the correct collective nouns,

7. fill in crossword puzzles using collective nouns,

8. search for more examples of collective nouns from print or non-print text,

9. collaborate to construct sentences using the collective nouns they have identified,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. list the collective nouns as they listen to an audio text,
2. identify collective nouns in a print text,
3. classify collective nouns according to people, animals or things,
4. discuss the plural forms of these nouns,
5. write correct sentences using collective nouns from substitution tables,
6. fill in blank spaces using the correct collective nouns,
7. fill in crossword puzzles using collective nouns,
8. search for more examples of collective nouns from print or non-print text,
9. collaborate to construct sentences using the collective nouns they have identified,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner shares what they have learnt while discussing plural forms of collective nouns.

• Communication and collaboration: It is developed as the learner contributes to group decision making while constructing

sentences with peers.

Values:
• Unity: It is developed as the learner collaborates with peers to construct sentences using the collective nouns they have

identified.

• Respect: It is developed as the learner appreciates the capabilities of others as they work in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective communication: This is enhanced as the learner uses collective nouns correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the learning of compound nouns to learning similar concepts in Kiswahili.
